scope: scripts/qualify_project_upgrade.py on a Debug build of 02e34fe, 66/66 steps, owned copies of four public example projects, each upgrade in its own empty owned Portal. The V13 archive TinyMySQLClient.zap13 is refused before any native call (ProjectVersionUnsupported, no admission, no upgrade directory) and the same archive renamed to .zap14 is refused by its project file's release; a missing archive is ProjectNotFound; per example a wrong hash (SourceChanged) and a second upgrade while a project is open (ProjectIsolationRequired) are refused without an admission. TinyMySQLClient_V14_1.zap14 (RetrieveWithUpgrade) becomes TinyMySQLClient_V14_V21, TinyMySQLClient_V15.ap15 becomes TinyMySQLClient_V15_V21 and 109482675_TimeSyn_Project_V15.1_V16.ap16 becomes 109482675_TimeSyn_Project_V15.1_V16_V21 (OpenWithUpgrade; TIA reports this one modified), each at the observed V21 location, with a conversion log to 21.0.0.0 that records success, an unchanged source copy and a returned admission; each reopens in a fresh owned Portal with the pinned inventory (17 hardware items, one PLC, 7, 7 and 2 blocks, none inconsistent). V21 refuses DigitalTwinAtEducation_TIAProject_Basic_V16.ap16 with MissingProductsException (its TP700 Comfort 15.0.0.0 panel is no longer supported): ProjectUpgradeFailed, source unchanged, no upgraded project, owned copy retained, admission returned. Every original is byte-identical before and after; the example copies are removed at the end and no run file names a folder above an example.
limitations: Four public example projects: one V14 SP1 archive, one V15 and two V16 project folders. V15.1 and V17-V20 sources are not exercised.
DigitalTwinAtEducation_TIAProject_Basic_V16 cannot be upgraded by V21 (TP700 Comfort 15.0.0.0 no longer supported, MissingProductsException); only that typed refusal is qualified for it.
The pinned inventory is device, PLC and block counts and PLC paths; content is not compared with the older version, which needs that TIA version.
Nothing is compiled: block consistency after the upgrade is recorded as TIA reports it.
Protected (UMAC) projects, locked sources and an interrupted upgrade (reconciliation) are not exercised natively.
